data.title: 约尔·福杰 · 月下屋顶·荆棘双针与冷艳杀气
data.description: 【约尔 · 月下屋顶·荆棘双针与冷艳杀气】清冷孤月高悬的都市钟楼屋顶之上，代号「荆棘公主」的顶级暗杀者身着一袭优雅性感的露背黑礼裙。她反握着泛着寒光的金色锥针，眼底凌厉的杀气如极北寒冰——「为了守护劳埃德先生与阿尼亚的和平生活……阻碍于此的害虫们，就由我彻底打扫干净吧。」
data.promptProse: Yor stands on a city clocktower roof in her black Thorn Princess halterneck dress, golden headpiece and stiletto heels. She grips her golden needle weapons in reverse, eyes focused with cold determination. The medium view places roof tiles below the near weapon and distant building silhouettes behind her. Clear moonlight catches the needles and bare upper back, leaving red rose-patterned lining darker within the dress folds.
data.action: 荆棘公主装束立于月下，杀气凛然
